params.body:
`stocklist:preview-refresh` failed on the box on 2026-09-16:

```
mysqldump: unknown variable 'set-gtid-purged=OFF'
```

The production server runs MariaDB, whose `mysqldump` does not know that MySQL-only flag. This drops it from `PreviewRefresh::commandLine()`: the dump is piped into the same server, so GTID handling does not matter here. No version probing, one flag less.

- `PreviewEnvironmentTest` pins that no `gtid` flag appears in either pipeline.
- `docs/preview.md`: one paragraph saying the box runs MariaDB and the dump only uses flags both know.

Tests: `PreviewEnvironmentTest`, `ScheduleTest`, `RulesCoverageTest`, `RulesIdentityTest` (20 tests, 97 assertions, green).
params.title: Preview refresh: mysqldump flags that MariaDB knows
